text:
Alex: Quick poll — who wants a pretzel run in 15? I can swing by the place on 9th.
Sam: me! salted pretzel pls :pretzel:
Maria: I will pay in oatmilk credits. can you also grab the matcha tin? we are out.
Jordan: Ooh matcha. how big is the tin? we usually need the ceremonial one.
Alex: It's the 200g bag from Little Leaf on 9th — they put it by the counter. I'll check stock.
Priya: FYI we actually have one half-open tin in the pantry labeled "code review tea" — smells like optimism.
Maria: lol @Priya bring it to the kitch table so we can assess.
KitchenBot: Inventory low: oatmilk 1L, matcha 0 units, sea salt pretzels 2 packs. Restock suggested: oatmilk, matcha 200g, pretzels.
Sam: @KitchenBot thanks. Alex — do you accept substitutions? (no pretzels = croissant?)
Alex: Prefer pretzels but croissant if they don't have them. also, any dietary requests? gluten-free?
Jordan: If GF option available, grab one for me. otherwise I'll survive.
Priya: I can't do nuts. avoid almond croissants pls.
Maria: Also, while you're there, check for that new honey butter. it's a game-changer.
Alex: Noted. Plan: 3 salted pretzels, 1 GF pretzel, matcha 200g, oatmilk (if they have the barista pack), honey butter if present. I'll be back ~ 12:10.
Sam: Amazing, you are our hero. :hero_with_purpose:
Jordan: I can Venmo you for my pretzel — how much?
Alex: Pretzel is $3.50 each. GF is $4.75. Matcha $12. I'll drop a list in #payments when back.
Maria: Also quick heads-up — fridge label: someone left mystery yogurt in the back with no name. I put a sticky note: "claim by Friday or compost".
Priya: Thanks. I think that was mine but it's been there a week, I give up.
KitchenBot: Reminder scheduled: "Kitchen tidy-up" tomorrow 4pm. Volunteers: 2/4 slots filled.
Sam: I'll help after standup.
Jordan: And I'll bring extra napkins.
Alex: Back in 12.
--- 18 minutes later ---
Alex: Returned. Took 14. They had matcha! Bought everything on the list plus honey butter and a tiny jar of lemon curd (impulse).
Sam: pics? :camera_with_flash:
Alex: Uploaded to #random — photo of glorious pretzels and matcha bag.
Maria: Smells like heaven. Tastes like victory. Thanks Alex! :pretzel::tea:
Jordan: GF pretzel is tasty. price confirmed. I'll Venmo now.
Priya: Saved me a snack-crisis. Lemon curd bless.
Alex: No problem. Total $29.25. @Sam, @Jordan, @Maria, @Priya please Venmo me when you can.
Sam: Venmo sent.
Jordan: Sent.
Priya: Sent $3.50 for my pretzel.
Maria: Sending $9 for matcha + my pretzel.
KitchenBot: Expense note: Alex reimbursed by peers. Entry created in team-expenses/2026-03.
Alex: Thanks all. Quick ask — can someone pop the matcha into the metal tin and label it "communal matcha"? the bag is by the sink.
Priya: On it.
Maria: Labelled and put by the sugar jar. Added scoop.
Alex: You're the best. Shortest mission, biggest morale boost.
Sam: Team cohesion += 1
Jordan: Snack run MVP: Alex. :trophy:
